title: fix(muya): open documents whose reference labels contain regex characters (#5578)
issueTitle: [Bug] A reference definition like `[c++]: url` stops the document from opening
why: Typing a reference definition with the label c++ under an existing [c++] reference should turn that reference into a link; per the report, the buggy build throws an 'Invalid regular expression' error building the regex from the c++ label, so the reference is never re-rendered as a link.
